channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Court allows 'homewrecker' suit against former Senator Sinema to proceed
item.description: A judge ruled that messages from former Senator Kyrsten Sinema establish jurisdiction, allowing a lawsuit under North Carolina's alienation of affection law to move forward.

item.title: Former Democratic operative sentenced in child exploitation case
item.description: A former Virginia Democratic Party finance chair and 2024 DNC delegate received a ten-year prison sentence for child sexual abuse material and related offenses.

item.title: Arizona voter law dispute reaches Supreme Court with warnings of 'absurd' outcome
item.description: Election experts caution the Supreme Court that a Ninth Circuit ruling could prevent removal of noncitizens from state voter rolls.

item.title: Former Governor Pataki says domestic threats now endanger freedoms
item.description: Former New York Governor George Pataki stated that the freedoms targeted on September 11, 2001, are now under threat from within the country.
